name: Aureluko
backstory: Child of Merluko and Aurebalo; grew up around takes stonework commissions at the market each morning,... in Gorff, and knows something of Birth Of Darinak.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether Birth Of Niergus is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what Birth Of Niergus actually meant, the way most people already have
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: trails his father's stonework stall through the morning, sorts the offcuts nobody wants into a pile he's slowly building a trade from himself

arc.premise: Aureluko wants to see the long-petitioned market roof actually go up before another season of open-air stalls, and he's started lining up stone and timber pledges from the market's own sellers before the temple's competing repairs claim the same coin and timber first.
